title: Voltas among 4 F&O stocks with a sharp rise in futures open interest - In Demand | The Economic Times
text:
As of August 17, futures open interest rose sharply in nine NSE F&O stocks, with total open interest increasing more than 8% from the previous trading session. A significant rise in futures open interest indicates a jump in the number of active, unexpired contracts, suggesting that market participants are either building fresh positions or increasing their existing exposure in these stocks.
